notes: Trips render and animate correctly over CARTO dark-matter with two vendor colors; readout progression (144 s @3s, 328 s @8s, 578 s @14s) confirms ~41 s/s speed, matching the ~60 s full-pass requirement with trailLength 180.

Uses deck.gl 8.9.35 with the standalone `new DeckGL({mapLib: maplibregl, mapStyle})` pattern and deprecated `rounded: true` prop; the dist bundle also tries to fetch mapbox-gl.css (blocked, harmless) — dated v8 API rather than v9 MapboxOverlay.
No legend explaining which color maps to which vendor; otherwise clean dark basemap with good trail contrast and a working Pause/Play button plus time readout.
